title: Ground Floor Use and Transparency Requirements on Tenth Avenue
previewText: The underlying ground floor level streetscape provisions of Section 32-30 (STREETSCAPE REGULATIONS), inclusive, shall apply, except that ground floor level street frontages along Tenth Avenue shall be considered Tier C street frontages.
